environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EKS cluster in namespace 'webapp'. Pod runs with default service account. No NetworkPolicy applied to the namespace. Ingress is a basic nginx-ingress with no header filtering. The application is exposed via ClusterIP service and nginx-ingress controller with default configuration. IMDSv2 is enabled on the EC2 nodes but pods can reach the metadata endpoint. No egress restrictions are in place.

config.imds: IMDSv2 enabled on nodes, hop limit 2 (pods can reach)
